institution.name: State University of New York at Oneonta

plan.notes: Source: SUNY Oneonta 2023-2024 Undergraduate Catalog (archived), official "Business Administration, B.S. - 4-Year Degree Map". The current catalog is 2025-2026; this map was transcribed from the archived 2023-2024 catalog and is filed honestly as 2023-2024 - disclosed here. The map uses the current "Dragon Academy" general-education framework (same as the current catalog). Business programs are AACSB-accredited (per catalog). Transcribed exactly as published: 15+16+15+15+15+15+15+15 = 121. Elective slots transcribed per the map's elective key (definitions documented in each slot note). MATH 1050/MATH 2230 and the COMM options are printed without course titles in the map - transcribed as codes with this disclosure; see the map's Math Course Guidance note. Prerequisite recorded only for the direct in-plan chain (ACCT 2122 after ACCT 2100).

courses.title: Liberal Arts Elective
courses.choice_note: Plan literal: "Liberal Arts Elective". Per the map's elective key, a Liberal Arts Elective is any course carrying a Liberal Arts (LA) attribute. Specific course not named.

courses.title: MATH 1050 OR MATH 2230
courses.choice_note: Plan literal: "MATH 1050 OR MATH 2230" (4 credits). Course titles not given in the degree map. See the map's Math Course Guidance note (students enter with different math backgrounds).
